ids: final-engine: ceiling corner above the left curtain
done.what: The living room's ceiling outline now runs to the frame's left edge and down the left curtain's heading (0.0605,0.059)→(0.03,0.037)→(0,0.019): the corner above the curtain takes the ceiling's finish — no grey wedge, no hard vertical edge at x≈53 (Olive Green and the transfer's Linen checked).

ids: final-engine: style transfer floor 'Natural grain' streaks
done.what: recolor no longer adds a synthetic per-column grain for the 'natural' sheen (the vertical 1 px streaks that cut across diagonal boards); a wood keeps the photo's own boards and joints (the detail layer) or its laid tile, and 'textured' keeps its faint weave fleck. Transfer floor, Ash Wide Plank and Slate Dark checked at 5×: the grain follows the boards.

ids: final-engine: kitchen island back panel (owner call)
done.what: The island's charcoal back panel under the overhang is part of the Charcoal Lower Cabinets: a new `keyed` outline on a surface (SurfaceDef.keyed, samples + model) — a part seen in pieces between things in front — is colour-keyed from seeds inside it (lightness counting fully, tight limit), checked again at full size against its seeds (`keepNear`) and kept off anything of clear hue (`offHue`: the stools' walnut legs and their shaded sides), with the three stools' seats and backs as cutouts. Sage Laminate now covers the panel between the stools; the stools keep their grey seats and walnut legs; the lit sliver at the panel's far right end stays as the photo's light.

ids: final-ui MAJOR: painting a relit version (Master bedroom V1 Golden Hour)
done.what: An edit, a note (colours) or a style transfer on a relit version is now made on the picture UNDER the light (the editor's `unlit`, from unlitSource) — so its regions are read on the room before the light, no sun patch or leaf shadow read as another colour — and the same light is laid again: each pixel keeps what the light did to it (lit ÷ unlit, per channel), so an unchanged pixel comes back exactly and the new wall carries the sun patches, leaf and pampas shadows and the lamps' glow; a pixel the light takes past white keeps its hue (the sun stays orange, not lemon). What 1.0's golden-hour render adds that the photo doesn't (the right nightstand's lit lamp, its moved candle) stays as rendered (`SampleRoom.relitKeep`). A pass that brings its own light (a preset or a note's preset) lays that one instead (lights never stack); a Remove on a relit version keeps the old path (the empty plate matched to the lit picture) — a ratio would print the removed piece's ghost. Checked: Master bedroom V1 (1.0 golden hour) → Ivory Cream walls; living room relit Golden Hour and Warm Cozy Home → Navy walls; relit living room → sofa Emerald velvet, a 'sage green walls' note, sofa Remove.

notDone.why: A second edit on a version that was itself edited under a light (V2 = walls on relit V1, then the floor on V2) runs on V2's own lit picture — the editor passes `unlit` only when the version on screen is a relight (unlitSource returns null for an edit). The pixel regions are read on the lit picture then, as before this fix. Carrying the light pair down the chain needs the editor to pass it (see crossFileRequests).

crossFileRequests.change: Optional follow-up: for a version whose finishes.lighting is set and that descends from a relight through edits, pass PassInput.unlit as that version's own picture divided by the relight's light (the engine can do the division if it gets the relight's lit and unlit urls) — not needed for the reported case (V1 relit), which is fixed.
